Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature: coordinated implementation plan + kickoff options

Hi Elena 

Thanks again for signing. Congratulations to the Suncrest team  excited to get started. I put together a compact mutual-action draft (attached) that embeds the rollout, canary windows, migration windows, and the evaluation plan we discussed on the call. The three things we need to lock this week so we can schedule engineering and training are:

- A preferred go-live cadence (two-week vs. four-week phased)
- The production canary window dates (we recommend 2x 72-hour windows)
- Decision on whether Suncrest will run the initial evaluation prompts internally or if Redwood should execute them during the pilot

Attached: Suncrest_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Evaluation_Prompts_v2.md (seed prompts and pass/fail criteria), Canary_Window_Timeline.pdf (visual).

Proposed next steps:
1) Pick a kickoff date: Sep 10 (tight) or Sep 17 (safe).
2) Confirm the two ops owners who will be on the weekly standups (we've tentatively listed @it-deploy and procurement).
3) Agree on rollback criteria for the canary (token-level latency > 250ms for three consecutive hours, or NPS drop > 10 points vs baseline).

If helpful, Marcus can run a 30-minute technical runthrough for your infra team before the kickoff.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
